mission_02: The wav2vec 2.0 feature encoder uses 7 convolutional layers; the first has stride 320 (20ms at 16kHz) and the rest have stride 1.
The contrastive loss computes cosine similarity between masked features and codebook entries, then applies cross-entropy with the correct entry as the target.
The diversity loss measures how uniformly codebook entries are used by computing the entropy of the average assignment probability distribution.
